WebView2 for SI AI Hub
======================

WebView2Loader.dll (x64 / x86 / arm64)
  Microsoft Edge WebView2 SDK 1.0.3650.58, redistributable loader.
  Taken unmodified from the webview2-com-sys 0.39.1 crate (crates.io), which ships the SDK files.
  Authenticode signed by Microsoft Corporation (Microsoft Code Signing PCA 2011).
  Verify on Windows: right-click -> Properties -> Digital Signatures, or
    powershell Get-AuthenticodeSignature .\x64\WebView2Loader.dll
  SHA256:
    86545b66cdb0603bc26b626fb9ad610cb6e71f28d468f5ea66df23b03dda96d5  x64/WebView2Loader.dll
    161dc6673084a31f64670ace8e61cb0e1b55af815b6c7c8217a0cdd8503454e2  x86/WebView2Loader.dll
    a0de1844933a10c898f833771a85f0ab9a0e3c745d4715f63d2d9730f9416025  arm64/WebView2Loader.dll

webview2_c.h
  Minimal C declarations of the WebView2 COM interfaces used by viewer.c.
  Generated by tools/gen_webview2_header.py from the official WebView2 metadata bindings
  (webview2-com-sys 0.39.1, SDK 1.0.3650.58): vtable slot order and IIDs come from the metadata;
  only the methods SI AI Hub calls are typed, every other slot is a pointer-size placeholder.
  Regenerate:
    python3 tools/gen_webview2_header.py <webview2-com-sys>/src/bindings.rs 1.0.3650.58 third_party/webview2/webview2_c.h
